CONTINGENCY FEE AGREEMENT
This Agreement is made on July 7, 2026 between Quarry Example LLP ("Firm") and Elm Street Sample Ltd ("Client").
The Firm will pursue the Client's unpaid invoice claim against a former customer.
The Client will pay the Firm a success fee of 15% of any amount recovered. No fee is payable if nothing is recovered.
The success fee is due within 10 days of the Firm receiving the recovered funds.
